description: This file contains implementation of advanced state-access functions related to HTTP message body processing, specifically handling multipart form data including boundary detection, header parsing, and saving file and non-file data chunks. It includes functions for finding boundaries, parsing headers, and processing the multipart data stream in buffer descriptors.

methods.name: BOOL HttpMboFindBoundaryPos(PUCHAR pData,ULONG ulDataLen,PUCHAR pBoundary,PULONG pulBoundaryPos)
methods.description: Finds the position of the boundary string within a data buffer, returning TRUE if found and setting the boundary position.

methods.name: BOOL HttpMboFindNextBoundary(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,ULONG ulStartPos,PULONG pulBoundaryPos)
methods.description: Finds the next boundary position in a buffer descriptor starting from a given offset.

methods.name: BOOL HttpMboFindNextBoundary2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hLastBdo,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,PBOOL pbFoundInLastBdo,PULONG pulOffset)
methods.description: Finds the next boundary position across two buffer descriptors, handling partial boundary data.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboParsePartHeaders(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,PULONG pulHeadersLen,PBOOL pbPartEndFound,PULONG pulPartEndOffset,PUCHAR * ppFieldName,PUCHAR * ppFileName,PBOOL pbFileData)
methods.description: Parses headers within a multipart part, extracting field name, filename, and detecting if it's a file.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboSaveNonFileData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,BOOL bEndFound,ULONG ulEndOffset,BOOL bHoldBoundary)
methods.description: Saves non-file multipart form data into a buffer descriptor queue.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboSaveFileData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG ulReqBodySize,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo,BOOL bEndFound,ULONG ulEndOffset,BOOL bHoldBoundary)
methods.description: Saves file data chunks from a buffer descriptor, passing them to the configured file upload handler.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS HttpMboProcessMPData(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBdo)
methods.description: Main function to process multipart data stream, handling boundary detection, header parsing, and data storage.
